key_insight: TreeC learns understandable energy-management strategies with performance competitive with model predictive control and reinforcement learning across diverse energy-management problems.
engineering_relevance: Energy-management algorithms can lower costs in electrified Belgian homes, but average savings do not yet outweigh current implementation costs and effort.
method: Compare rule-based, optimization, and machine-learning energy management.
Develop TreeC to learn understandable control strategies.
Evaluate management of batteries, heat pumps, and other energy-related systems.
evidence_signal: Three simulation cases and one real-world experiment support the comparison; TreeC and model predictive control both performed worse on hardware than in simulation.
watch_item: Deployment requires representative training data and reliable real-time inputs, whose shortcomings reduced TreeC and model predictive control performance, respectively.
paper_title: How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
